Diagnostic.description: A rule broken: its code, how it counts, and where.

code.description: The rule's code, one of the specification's codes table or one of the tool's own, such as `UNRESOLVED_ADDRESS`.

message.description: What is wrong and what to do about it, in a sentence.

related.description: Other places the diagnostic is about.

Diagnostic.title: Diagnostic

Location.description: Where a diagnostic is: a file, and a place in it.

column.description: The column of the place in its line, counted from 1.

commit.description: The full id of the commit the file is read at. Left out for the working tree.

file.description: The file's path from the top of the repository that holds it.

key.description: The map key or field the diagnostic names at the place.

line.description: The line of the place in the file, counted from 1.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer to the place in the file. The whole file is the empty string.

url.description: The URL of the remote the file is read from, if any.

Location.title: Location

diagnostics.description: The rules broken, in the order of their places.

root.description: The driving analysis's `astra.yaml`, as a path from the top of the repository that holds it.

shape.description: The name and version of this shape.

unchecked.description: The codes of the validator rules the tool didn't check, so that a report with no diagnostic for them says nothing of them.

valid.description: Whether the analysis is valid: no diagnostic is an error.
